name: au-property-development
description: Use this guide to prepare the income tax evidence on whether profit from an Australian land subdivision, development or sale is capital or revenue: mere realisation of a capital asset, an isolated profit-making undertaking (TR 92/3), or a business of property development in which land is trading stock (TD 92/124, s 70-10 ITAA 1997), including changes of intention and lot-level workpapers. Covers individuals, trusts, partnerships and companies for 2026-27. Trigger on 'revenue or capital', 'isolated transaction', 'profit-making scheme', 'subdivision profit', 'property developer income', 'land as trading stock', 'mere realisation' or 'change of intention'.
